compute_inception_score: compute the Inception Score (IS) for a GAN generator using a pretrained Inception v3 detector model
run_inception_score_evaluation: run the inception score metric on generated images by passing opts, num_gen, and num_splits to compute_is

review_compute_is_function: review the compute_is function that returns mean and std Inception Score using the Salimans et al. implementation
